manifest.title_fil: Gamitin ang 7S sa lugar ng trabaho
manifest.title_en: Use 7S to improve the work area
objectives_fil: Suriin ang kathang-isip na work area gamit ang lahat ng 7S at magtakda ng pagbabago, responsable at petsa ng pagsusuri.
objectives_en: Inspect a simulated work area using all seven categories and assign an improvement, owner and review date.

sections.takeaway_fil: Walang responsable o petsa ng pagsusuri.
Gamit ang ligtas na props, suriin ang lahat ng 7S sa mesa ni Tess. Magtalaga ng isang pagbabago, responsable, petsa at ebidensiya.
sections.takeaway_en: Using safe props, inspect all seven categories at Tess’s desk. Assign one improvement, owner, date and evidence.

sections.takeaway_fil: Inaayos ang kailangang gamit ayon sa paggamit.
sections.takeaway_en: Needed items are arranged according to use.

options.fil: Ayusin ang forms ayon sa gamit.
Maghintay ng utos bago gawin ang sariling tungkulin.
options.en: Wait for reminders before carrying out assigned duties.

options.fil: Gumawa ng magkakaibang label araw-araw upang laging bago.
options.en: Make different labels daily so they are always new.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Inaayos ang kailangang gamit ayon sa paggamit. 2: Salungat ito sa self-discipline at hindi pag-aayos ng gamit. 3: Kailangan ng napagkasunduang standard, hindi pabago-bagong label.
check.feedback_en: 1: Needed items are arranged according to use. 2: This conflicts with self-discipline and does not arrange supplies. 3: A shared standard is needed, not changing labels.

sections.takeaway_fil: Nasusuri ang lahat ng pitong kategorya at may ligtas, awtorisadong pagbabago na may responsable at petsa ng pagbalik.
sections.takeaway_en: Checks all seven categories and proposes a safe, authorized improvement with an owner and review date.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang saklaw at kailangan sa tamang tao.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm boundaries and requirements with the appropriate person.

sections.takeaway_fil: May pananagutan at pagbalik sa resulta, hindi minsanang paglilinis.
sections.takeaway_en: This provides responsibility and follow-up beyond one cleaning session.

check.prompt_fil: Nalinis na ang mesa. Ano ang makatutulong upang magpatuloy ang 7S?
check.prompt_en: The desk is clean. What helps 7S continue?

options.fil: Alisin ang checklist para wala nang susunod na gawain.
options.en: Remove the checklist so there are no further tasks.

options.fil: Itakda ang tao, routine at review.
options.en: Assign an owner, routine and review.

options.fil: Sabihing tapos na ang lahat dahil isang beses nang nalinis.
options.en: Declare everything finished because it was cleaned once.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Nawawala ang gabay sa pagpapanatili. 2: May pananagutan at pagbalik sa resulta, hindi minsanang paglilinis. 3: Hindi nito sinusuri kung napapanatili ang pitong kategorya.
check.feedback_en: 1: The guide for maintaining the work is lost. 2: This provides responsibility and follow-up beyond one cleaning session. 3: This does not check whether the seven categories are maintained.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.

assets.alt_fil: Tatlong kahon: Suriin ang 7S, Itakda ang gawain, Balikan ang resulta.
assets.alt_en: Three boxes: Check all seven, Assign the action, Review the result.
